lines.text: Castor Home Health Solutions delivers care — from home nursing to medical supplies.
But four businesses meant four separate websites, and a fragmented experience.
Patients jumped from tab to tab, just to find the right service.
Then Isofiniti stepped in, and unified it all.
One digital ecosystem — for service discovery, referrals, commerce, and future automation.
Designed, developed, integrated, and tested — end to end.
The new Castor experience is live. Modern, unified, and easy to navigate.
A connected experience. Easier discovery. Simpler management. Built for growth.
From four disconnected websites, to one unified platform.
One digital ecosystem, for four Castor businesses.
Isofiniti. We build digital ecosystems that simplify complexity.
